verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers Document Driver®, described as a free tool that generates formation documents for a Delaware C-Corp, multi-member LLC or single-member LLC, and the site presents itself as free information and tools. That covers the incorporation part of the story. The SAFE material is only an explanatory guide, the calculators model dilution and exit proceeds rather than generating documents, and no NDA or term-sheet forms appear. Missing for 10: SAFE/term-sheet document generators or downloadable templates, NDA templates, explicit confirmation that no client relationship or account is required, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client

citations.quote: Our Document Driver® product is the best free tool to get you started with forming a corporation or LLC.
Our Document Driver® enables you to generate documents to form either a Delaware corporation or LLC.
Founders Workbench is a resource to help ease the process by providing you with free information and tools
